title: A traffic light
description:
Model a traffic light with an enum.

```
Red (30 s) -> Green
Green (25 s) -> Yellow
Yellow (5 s) -> Red
Flashing: stays Flashing
```
hints: `if let Some(s) = light.seconds()` prints the time only when there is one.
requirements: `enum Light { Red, Yellow, Green, Flashing }` with `#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]`.
`fn next(self) -> Light` and `fn seconds(self) -> Option<u32>` (`Flashing` has no time).
stretch: Add a pedestrian button: `fn press(self) -> Light` that makes a green light turn yellow straight away.
